decisions.reason: The instruction to make sure information is 'in there' may impose a before-clock-out artifact submission deadline, but the source does not unambiguously identify the linked Google documents or folders as the destination.
The source establishes a specific task schedule but does not change the fallback behavior for independently selecting work when an assignment is unavailable.
The source sets completion and check-in times but does not instruct the freelancer to mark completed tasks in ClickUp or otherwise change task-status handling.
The scheduled work concerns Pinterest Tasks 1 and 2, not completion, visibility, or storage of the CRM structure document.
